pages.purpose: Open on four lanterns and approaching weather
pages.beat: At the gate, Rabbit taps four unlit picnic lanterns; wind rattles their handles.
requiredContinuity: Four lanterns mark the route
Neighbors need the path before moonrise
pages.endingPressure: The weather threatens the marked route.

pages.beat: Rabbit skips to the bridge while Wise Turtle checks its lantern on the far-side post.
requiredContinuity: Bridge lantern starts on the far-side post
pages.endingPressure: Three more markers need checking.

pages.beat: Wise Turtle checks the bend lantern; Rabbit points out the fork lantern farther along.
requiredContinuity: Bend and fork lanterns are at their intended markers
pages.endingPressure: The clearing marker remains ahead.

pages.purpose: Complete the route before the storm
pages.beat: At the clearing, they check the fourth lantern; a gust snaps leaves against its handle.
requiredContinuity: Clearing lantern starts at the clearing
All four lanterns remain unlit
pages.endingPressure: The gust becomes a storm.

pages.beat: Rain drums through the woods; when it stops, all four lanterns have vanished.
requiredContinuity: All four lanterns are displaced
The route is dark
pages.endingPressure: Rabbit rushes to restore the route.

pages.purpose: Let Rabbit's haste misplace a lantern
pages.beat: Rabbit finds the bend lantern by an eastward stump and hangs it at the fork.
requiredContinuity: Bend lantern moves from stump to wrong fork
Bridge and bend remain unmarked
pages.endingPressure: The quick fix points visitors onward.

pages.beat: Wise Turtle follows the familiar path and finds a fallen branch across the bend.
requiredContinuity: Branch blocks the bend
Wise Turtle favors clearing the old path
pages.endingPressure: Searching and clearing now compete for time.

pages.beat: As they disagree, a damp breeze swings Rabbit's lantern toward the wrong trail.
requiredContinuity: Bend lantern still hangs at wrong fork
Its light would misdirect a neighbor
pages.endingPressure: Rabbit must undo the misleading sign.

pages.beat: Rabbit takes down the lantern, carries it back to the stump, and waits.
requiredContinuity: Bend lantern is back at eastward stump
Fork has no lantern
pages.endingPressure: Waiting gives them a chance to compare clues.

pages.purpose: Reveal the bridge lantern's landing place
pages.beat: Beyond the bridge, Wise Turtle spots a lantern caught in near-bank reeds.
requiredContinuity: Bridge lantern is in near-bank reeds east of its post
Neither lantern has been retrieved
pages.endingPressure: Two displaced lanterns can now be compared.

pages.purpose: Turn observed places into a prediction
pages.beat: Wise Turtle compares reeds east of bridge with stump east of bend and predicts an eastward drift.
requiredContinuity: Both observed lanterns landed east of their markers
Prediction points east of fork and clearing
pages.endingPressure: The untested pattern suggests the next search.

pages.purpose: Test the pattern at the fork
pages.beat: Rabbit follows Wise Turtle's suggestion to the bramble east of the fork and spots light beneath wet leaves.
requiredContinuity: Fork lantern is beneath leaves at eastward bramble
Eastward prediction has its first test
pages.endingPressure: A caught hook keeps the lantern there.

pages.beat: Rabbit holds leaves aside instead of pulling; Wise Turtle frees the sound lantern's hook.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit carries the freed fork lantern
Lantern and hook are sound
pages.endingPressure: The clearing lantern remains missing.

pages.purpose: Apply the tested clue farther on
pages.beat: They head east of the clearing; Rabbit reaches the hollow log first and calls for Wise Turtle.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit still carries fork lantern
Both search east of clearing
pages.endingPressure: The log may hold the last lantern.

pages.beat: Wise Turtle hears glass clink deep inside the log and asks Rabbit not to reach blindly.
requiredContinuity: Clearing lantern is deep inside eastward hollow log
Wise Turtle joins Rabbit at the log
pages.endingPressure: They need a way to draw it out.

pages.beat: Rabbit guides it forward with a fallen twig while Wise Turtle steadies the log; together they lift it out.
requiredContinuity: All four landing places are known
Clearing lantern is retrieved
pages.endingPressure: The blocked bend still prevents a clear route.

pages.beat: Rabbit offers to carry the lanterns back quickly; Wise Turtle insists they try clearing the old path.
requiredContinuity: Fork and clearing lanterns are with the pair
Bridge and bend lanterns remain where found
pages.endingPressure: The branch must be assessed before they choose.

pages.purpose: Prove the branch cannot be moved
pages.beat: At the bend, both push the branch; it stays put as the moon nears the treetops.
requiredContinuity: Branch remains across the old bend
Picnic arrival must precede moonrise
pages.endingPressure: Wise Turtle's preferred route will not work.

pages.beat: Rabbit spots a short way around over dry ground and invites Wise Turtle to test it.
requiredContinuity: Dry detour goes around the branch
No one relies on it yet
pages.endingPressure: Its footing still needs checking.

pages.purpose: Let Wise Turtle choose a new way
pages.beat: Wise Turtle tests each step, finds firm ground, and agrees to guide visitors around the branch.
requiredContinuity: Dry detour is checked and approved
Branch remains in place
pages.endingPressure: The lanterns must make that turn clear.

pages.beat: Rabbit fetches the lantern from the stump and hangs it at the bend where visitors can see the detour.
requiredContinuity: Bend lantern moves from stump to bend
Fork lantern remains with Rabbit
pages.endingPressure: The bridge remains dark.

pages.beat: At the near-bank reeds, Wise Turtle stays on firm ground while Rabbit draws out the bridge lantern.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit holds bridge lantern
Bend lantern hangs at bend
pages.endingPressure: The recovered marker needs its proper post.

pages.beat: Rabbit crosses first with the lantern; Wise Turtle follows, and they hang it on the far-side post.
requiredContinuity: Bridge lantern hangs at its original post
Both stand beyond the bridge
pages.endingPressure: Two markers still need hanging.

pages.purpose: Restore the fork without repeating the error
pages.beat: Rabbit hangs the bramble lantern at its true fork marker and checks the turn from a visitor's approach.
requiredContinuity: Fork lantern hangs at intended fork marker
Rabbit checks its direction
pages.endingPressure: The clearing still needs its marker.

pages.purpose: Complete and light the safe route
pages.beat: Wise Turtle hangs the hollow-log lantern at the clearing; together they light all four and check the detour.
requiredContinuity: All four lanterns are lit at intended markers
Checked detour is visible at bend
pages.endingPressure: Waiting neighbors still need an escort.

pages.beat: Back at the gate, Rabbit waits beside Wise Turtle as the neighbors gather beneath the darkening sky.
requiredContinuity: Both helpers are at the gate
Four lit lanterns mark the checked route
pages.endingPressure: The group must arrive before moonrise.

pages.purpose: Guide the group across the bridge
pages.beat: Rabbit calls the picnic tune at the bridge; Wise Turtle waits until the last neighbor crosses.
requiredContinuity: Group passes the bridge together
pages.endingPressure: The bend requires an unfamiliar turn.

pages.purpose: Use the detour without losing anyone
pages.beat: Rabbit calls from the lit bend while Wise Turtle guides the last neighbor over the tested dry ground.
requiredContinuity: Group passes the branch by the checked detour
No neighbor is left behind
pages.endingPressure: The final fork still needs a clear choice.

pages.beat: Rabbit calls at the fork; Wise Turtle checks behind, and the neighbors reach the clearing before moonrise.
requiredContinuity: All neighbors reach the picnic before moonrise
All four lanterns remain lit
pages.endingPressure: The helpers can finally join the picnic.

pages.beat: Rabbit sits for a quiet bite beside Wise Turtle while the four lanterns shine along the path home.
requiredContinuity: Rabbit stays with the group
Wise Turtle trusts their checked new route
pages.endingPressure: The safe path remains ready for home.

chapters.title: The Scattered Lights
chapters.summary: A storm scatters four markers, and Rabbit's hurried repair makes the route misleading.

chapters.title: Following the Wind
chapters.summary: Wise Turtle compares two landing places, and the pair tests the pattern to recover the remaining lanterns.

chapters.title: A New Way Around
chapters.summary: The blocked bend prompts Rabbit to propose a detour and Wise Turtle to test it.

chapters.title: Lighting the Route
chapters.summary: They restore all four lanterns to their intended markers and make the checked route visible.

chapters.title: Together to the Picnic
chapters.summary: Rabbit and Wise Turtle escort every neighbor to the clearing before moonrise.
